k:黒.mnemonic: A stove with its little window at the top and flames licking underneath, and everything above the fire coated in soot. Black.

k:捕.mnemonic: It takes all ten (十) fingers (扌) for the task (用) of grabbing a slippery fish as it leaps past. Catch (capture).
k:捕.hint: Both hands round a leaping fish.

k:央.mnemonic: A big (大) man with a target painted on his forehead (冖). The bullseye sits exactly midway between his ears. Center (middle, centre).
k:央.hint: Bullseye on a big man's brow.

k:永.mnemonic: Water (水) wearing down a rock one drop (丶) at a time. The dripping never stops, and it has all the time there is. Eternity (long, lengthy, length).

k:友.mnemonic: There is one (一) slide (ノ) in the playground, and when you go down it, she comes down also (又), right behind you, laughing. Friend.

k:求.mnemonic: Offered all eternity (永), you still raise a finger and ask for just one (一) more day on top. Request (want, wish for, demand).

k:根.mnemonic: The stubborn (艮) part of a tree (木): the bit that grips the ground and will not come out however hard you pull. Root (radical).
k:根.hint: The part that won't pull out.

k:管.mnemonic: A bureaucrat (官) too lazy to leave his desk has a length of hollow bamboo (竹) run to the next office and shouts his orders down it. Pipe (tube, wind instrument, control).

k:藤.mnemonic: For one month (月) each year, purple flowers (艹) pour down from the trellis like water (水) falling from heaven (天). Wisteria.

k:負.mnemonic: He tries to cradle (勹) his last shellfish (貝) coin in his arms, but the bet is lost and he must hand it over. Defeat (negative, minus, bear).

k:図.mnemonic: An astronomer draws a fence (囗) of four lines on the page and carefully plots the Big Dipper (斗) inside it, star by star. Diagram (map, plan, drawing).

k:構.mnemonic: The fencing master in his hood (冂) balances a book (本) on each pupil's head and makes them hold their guard for a count of ten (十). Posture (stance, appearance, build).

k:催.mnemonic: The leader (亻) pays for a feast on top of the mountain (山): a roast turkey (隹) for every guest, and his name on the banner. Sponsor (hold a meeting, give a dinner).
k:催.hint: Chief pays for the hilltop feast.

k:商.mnemonic: Under the hood (冂) of a market stall, two traders compete (競) on price, going back and forth until they finally shake hands. Make a deal (selling, merchant, sell).

k:久.mnemonic: A bent old figure leaning forward, with a stick trailing behind: someone who has been walking this road for years and years. Long time (old story).
k:久.hint: Bent old walker with a stick.

k:与.mnemonic: From above (上), a hand lowers a gift into arms held out like a cradle (勹) to take it. Bestow (give, award, impart).

k:想.mnemonic: Two people look at each other and the same picture forms in each heart (心) at once: a mutual (相) spark, shared before a word is said. Concept (idea, think, thought).

k:岩.mnemonic: A stone (石) the size of a house that has rolled off the mountain (山) and come to rest in the valley. Boulder (rock, cliff, stone).

k:森.mnemonic: A tree (木), and another, and another on top: trunks in every direction and no sky showing through. Forest (woods).

k:属.mnemonic: Each wolf pack marks its flag (尸) with its own paw print (禸). A cub holds its foot against the print and knows which pack is its own. Belong (genus, affiliated).
k:属.hint: Paw print on the pack's banner.

k:資.mnemonic: A merchant stacks one shellfish (貝) coin, then the next (次), then the next, building up the pile that will fund his business. Assets (resources, capital, funds).

k:接.mnemonic: A woman (女) at the market stands (立) in front of the silk and cannot resist running her fingers (扌) across it. Touch (contact, adjoin, piece together).

k:装.mnemonic: A samurai (士) stands stiff as a plank (爿) while servants wrap him in garment (衣) after garment for the ceremony. Attire (dress, pretend, disguise).

k:皿.mnemonic: A plate rack seen from the front: a flat base, and upright dividers with the crockery slotted between them. Dish (a helping, plate).

k:臣.mnemonic: A wide-open eye turned on its side: the servant who bows low before the lord but keeps one eye up, watching for orders. Retainer (subject).

k:監.mnemonic: The retainer (臣) leans over each dish (皿) before it goes to the lord's table, checking every one from above. Oversee (official, rule, administer).

k:提.mnemonic: He lifts the plan up in his fingers (扌) for everyone to see: 'How about we do it just so (是)?' Propose (take along, carry in hand).
k:提.hint: Holding the plan up: like this?

k:争.mnemonic: Two cleaners each cradle (勹) one end of the only broom (ヨ) and tug. Neither can complete (了) the sweeping until the other lets go. Contend (dispute, argue).
k:争.hint: Tug of war over a broom.

k:河.mnemonic: So much water that it can (可) carry whole barges, a slow tsunami (氵) rolling to the sea between two banks. River (stream, flow, current).
